title: Formulation process stages (nominal set of `use.phase`)
note: `usage_view_phase` is the phase letter (A to E) the stage projects to in the usage view (SPEC section 6.1); a stage without it is not projected. `usage_view_process: "cold"` marks the stage that sets `process: "cold"` in the usage view, so a cold-processed material needs no phase letter.

terms.label: Water phase (heated)
terms.definition: Part of the heated water phase.

terms.label: Oil phase (heated)
terms.definition: Part of the heated oil phase.

terms.label: Cool-down phase
terms.definition: Added after emulsification, below about 40 Cel.

terms.label: Added to the hot water phase
terms.definition: Dispersed or dissolved into the already heated water phase.

terms.label: Added to the hot oil phase
terms.definition: Dispersed or dissolved into the already heated oil phase.

terms.label: Pre-dispersion / premix
terms.definition: Pre-dispersed or pre-wetted in a part of the formula before the main phases.

terms.label: Post-emulsification (hot)
terms.definition: Added right after emulsification, before cooling.

terms.label: Surfactant phase
terms.definition: Part of the surfactant base of a cleansing product.

terms.label: Final adjustment
terms.definition: Added last (pH, viscosity or fragrance adjustment).

terms.label: Powder phase
terms.definition: Part of the powder phase of a decorative or anhydrous product.
